description: A cohort the person previously discussed has since closed; only `cohort-2026-b` is currently available. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-7), and INVERTED from `policy_blocked` to `succeeded`. WHY THE INVERSION: `offerAvailableGate` blocks only when the model NAMES an offer outside `availableOffers`. Nothing in the input forces that — a well-behaved model emits `cohort-2026-b` or the `undetermined` sentinel and passes. Requiring `policy_blocked` would require the model to invent a stale offer, and under D6.3 a model that behaved correctly would be graded CRITICAL for succeeding, forever; a fixture cannot require misbehaviour. The offer-availability BLOCK path stays covered by FOS1-NBA-09, which drives the output directly. Note this fixture is now MORE informative than the v1 version, not less: because `promptVocabularies` discloses `availableOffers` (plus the sentinel) to the model, a failure of the assertion below means the model invented an offer it was shown the complete set for — a real finding, where before it was the expected outcome. v1's third constraint — 'the model must not fall back to the undetermined sentinel merely to dodge the gate when it actually named a specific stale offer' — is a judgment about MOTIVE, with no structural operator and none invented for it (design section 6.1); it stays here, asserted by nothing.
